ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Which is the following is predator?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, marking Spartina, Prokelisia, Pardosa, Grammonota, Tytthus, and Hogna. Hogna is drawn as a larger spider, located at the top of the diagram; there are multiple arrows pointing from the positions of other animals to Hogna. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy flowing from the organism that is eaten to the predator, that is, from the food/prey to the consumer. Hogna receives arrows from other animals, indicating that it eats these animals; an organism that eats other animals is a predator. Therefore, the predator is Hogna.
